items.title: George "Kid Sheik" Colar Interview, 1958-07-20
items.q: he worked at us a couple of times in our brass band, he worked at me

ctx.x: You see, I worked with George back at Benefit and St. Rock, and I had my band on the side, you see. At that time, I couldn't make it with George, because I had my little side band, you see. And we worked right there a good while, but after that, I had jobs, that well, uh, um, Loran, he's got my band, well, he stood there a good while, you know, the way he, you know, he likes to drink, playing and all, so, uh, I guess George had to, you know, make a chance, so that's when, uh, Cuckoo got in the band.

Yeah, yeah, and he got in there when he was with George, and he stood with George, you know, until he passed, and he worked at us a couple of times in our brass band, he worked at me, he worked at me. While he's working, you know, when he's working out there, and every night there, like, uh, like, the Pat Alfredo's working. At Morocco?
